introHtml: Merchant Craft brings a rustic, farmhouse aesthetic to everyday household essentials. Their signature galvanized steel and wood accents make these items stand out as thoughtful corporate gifts or employee incentives. Whether you choose a caddy, tray, or utensil holder, each piece offers a large surface area for screen printing or engraving your logo. Perfect for real estate agent closing gifts, hospitality welcome packages, or holiday party favors that recipients will actually keep on display.
